from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,subprocess
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
repo=Path('/home/claude/code/EKA2L1')
rows=[]
for game in ['standard','combat']:
    journal=None;work=None;endpoints=None
    for repetition in range(2):
        for variant in (['baseline','candidate'] if repetition==0 else ['candidate','baseline']):
            name=f'{game}-{repetition}-{variant}';out=root/'timings'/name
            command=['python3',str(repo/'src/tests/benchmark/memory_implementations.py'),str(out),'timings',
                '--build',str(root/f'{variant}-build'),'--snakes-assets','/home/claude/.scratch/eka-benchmark/assets',
                '--sky-assets','/home/claude/.scratch/eka-sky-performance/assets','--reference-root','/home/claude/.scratch/eka-chrome-profiling',
                '--games',game,'--modes','2','--rounds','1','--window-us','4000000' if game=='standard' else '6000000']
            out.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
            (out.parent/(name+'-command.json')).write_text(json.dumps(command,indent=2))
            print('START',name,flush=True)
            with (out.parent/(name+'.log')).open('w') as log:subprocess.run(command,cwd=repo,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True,timeout=1800)
            result=json.loads((out/'results.json').read_text())[0];report=result['report']
            current=(out/result['name']/'frames.jsonl').read_bytes()
            measurement=report['measurement']
            current_endpoints={k:v for k,v in measurement.items() if 'instructions' in k or 'virtual' in k}
            if journal is None:journal=current;work=result['instructions'];endpoints=current_endpoints
            assert current==journal and result['instructions']==work and current_endpoints==endpoints,'Guest work changed'
            assert report['wasm_sha256']==hashlib.sha256((root/f'{variant}-build/eka2l1.wasm').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            result.update(variant=variant,repetition=repetition,presentation_journal_sha256=hashlib.sha256(current).hexdigest())
            rows.append(result)
            (root/'timing-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2))
            print('PASS',name,'worker CPU',report['cpu_time']['busiest_renderer_thread']['cpu_seconds'],flush=True)
